evidence: Filtering by API showed only 5 API-module docs; selecting All restored all 19 docs across modules.

Selecting 'REST API Design Guidelines' displayed title, version v2.3.0, updated 2024-01-15, three content sections, and 4 related documents (api-versioning, error-handling, http-methods, rate-limiting).
Clicking the 'API Versioning Strategy' link in the expanded rest-principles section navigated to that document (doc.title now 'API Versioning Strategy').

Clicking 'Versioning Approaches' section toggle changed its state from open to closed; content field disappeared and its link.rest-api-design became a disabled 'Expand section to access link' placeholder instead of the live link.
Re-clicking the collapsed 'Versioning Approaches' toggle restored state=open, its content text, and the live link.rest-api-design link.

Clicking the disabled link on a collapsed section showed toast 'Please expand the section to access links' and kept the document unchanged; after expanding the section, clicking the same link navigated to 'Error Handling Standards'.

Section toggle state field (open/closed) consistently matched whether content/links fields were present: open sections show content+live links, closed sections omit content and show disabled placeholder links.
Parsed source data for all 19 documents: none includes its own id in relatedDocs or in section link docIds.
Clicking a graph node set its state to 'selected' (visible glow indicator in DOM); Zoom In changed 100%->120%; Reset View restored 100%.

Graph shows exactly 19 nodes matching all 19 documents across all 5 modules, and 19 edges matching the deduplicated set of relatedDocs relationships computed from source data. Reset View / zoom controls bring the full graph back to the default 100% view.

Each of the 19 graph nodes has a fill color keyed to its document's module (verified via MODULE_COLORS mapping in source and matching node circle fill attributes), and 19 line elements connect nodes matching all unique relatedDocs relationships.

Clicking the 'JWT Authentication' graph node set selectedDocumentId without switching the active tab (Knowledge Graph remained active, graph.zoom stayed 100%); switching to Documents tab afterward immediately showed 'JWT Authentication' as the open document, and returning to Graph tab preserved zoom at 100%.
Successfully switched among all three tabs: Documents, Knowledge Graph, and Favorites; each became 'active' in nav and displayed its respective view.

Selected document 'JWT Authentication', its collapsed section states (token-structure/token-validation both closed), and graph zoom (140%) all remained unchanged after switching Graph->Documents->Favorites->Graph.

issue: Favorites view does not expose all favorited documents when a module filter is active in Documents view
actual: With Documents module filter set to 'API', Favorites tab (badge showing count=2) displayed 'No favorites yet' empty state even though 2 documents (jwt-authentication [Authentication], database-schema [Data Layer]) were favorited. Resetting the Documents filter to 'All' made both favorited items reappear in the Favorites list. Favorites count updates immediately and markers survive sort-by-date, which both work correctly, but the module-filter isolation for Favorites fails.
